message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942‑1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army (commanded by General Georgy Zhukov, with later leadership by General Vasily Chuikov).
• **Nazi Germany** – Wehrmacht’s 6th Army (initially under General Friedrich Paulus), supported by Luftwaffe and other Axis forces. | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now **Volgograd**) in southern Russia, situated on the banks of the **Volga River**. The battle took place in and around the urban area, with fighting extending into the surrounding countryside and the Volga’s strategic crossings. | The battle is widely regarded as one of the turning points of World War II, marking the first major defeat of the German army on the Eastern Front.
